1. Expect any correct KSL sentence with the following signs: (4 MARKS)
 i. ELECT/ INSIDE//
 ii. WHERE//
 iii. PARLIAMENT//

2. Expect the learner to sign as below: (5 MARKS)
 i. DISEASE//
 ii. COUGH//
 iii. SYRUP // LEARNER SIGNS
 iv. INJECT//
 v. HEADACHE//
3. Expect the learner to correctly identify each animal and respond in KSL structures that mean the following: (3 MARKS)
 i. -MONKEY SELF SCRATCH SCRATCH//
 -TREE JUMP JUMP//
 -MAIZE/BANANA STEAL//
 ii. LION MEAT/OTHER ANIMAL EAT//
 iii. SWIM TIME WATER/WALK TIME LAND//
4. Expect the learner to sign the correct way worship activities are done in each pictured place of worship. (3 MARKS)
 i. HINDU-TEMPLE and the correct sign for praying as a HINDU
 ii. CHRISTIAN-CHURCH and the correct sign(s) for praying as a CHRISTIAN (CATHOLIC/PROTESTANT)
 iii. MUSLIM-MOSQUE and the correct sign for praying as a MUSLIM
5. Expect the learner to sign correctly the sentences below: (2 MARKS)
i) VILLAGE OUR GOVERNOR TREE PLANT//
ii) COUNTY KILIFI DECEMBER VISIT/ RAILWAY USE//
